propositions: The 785-line runner.py and 388-line run() method must be re-evaluated for ownership boundaries against the current architecture without repeating ADR 0056/0058 extractions or introducing generic hook/plugin frameworks.

A complete effect/resource timeline audit (event-loop, config, tracing, provider/session, model/fallback, capability/cache, execution, failure accounting, answer attribution, logging, finalization) must be mapped with its current owner and required ordering.

A fault matrix must characterize resource closure, failure accounting, and provenance behavior across raising boundaries (pre/post-provider, fallback, execution, finalization) to identify incorrect ownership or missing guards.
Mutable provenance and post-call answer attribution must be modeled as the actual call graph treats them, rejecting any proposed frozen/immutable carriers around values mutated after construction.

The research must conclude either (a) that current decomposition is correct and no restructuring is warranted, with evidence recorded, or (b) identify a specific seam where exactly one existing module gains responsibility and specific code is deleted, with ADR amendment if needed.
